comments.body: Need to confirm histogram bucket bounds with observability — current default may crush the sub-10ms verify stage.

content.text: Need to confirm histogram bucket bounds with observability — current default may crush the sub-10ms verify stage.

Billing webhook handlers only emit counter metrics for success/failure. When payment events pile up, we cannot tell whether latency lives in signature verification, payload parse, or the ledger write — paging on error rate alone is too late.

Instrument each handler stage with structured histograms: billing.webhook.verify_ms, billing.webhook.parse_ms, and billing.webhook.persist_ms, labeled by event_type and outcome. Export via the existing OTel pipeline with 50/90/99 quantiles.
Acceptance: dashboards show the three stages for invoice.paid and customer.subscription.updated, and an alert fires when p99 of persist_ms exceeds 800ms for 5 minutes.
